sn35.117:1.1: pubbeva me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi.
sn35.117:1.2: yeme pañcakāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā, tatra me cittaṃ bahulaṃ gacchamānaṃ gaccheyya, paccuppannesu vā, appaṃ vā anāgatesu.
sn35.117:1.4: yeme pañcakāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā, tatra me attarūpena appamādo sati cetaso ārakkho karaṇīyo.
sn35.117:1.5: tasmātiha bhikkhave, tumhākampi ye vo pañcakāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā, nanu vo cittaṃ bahulaṃ gacchamānaṃ gaccheyya paccuppannesu vā appaṃ vā anāgatesu.
sn35.117:1.6: tasmātiha bhikkhave, tumhākampi ye vo pañcakāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā tatra vo attarūpehi appamādo sati cetaso ārakkho karaṇīyo.
sn35.117:1.7: tasmātiha bhikkhave, se āyatane veditabbe, yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati, rūpasaññā ca virajjati, se āyatane veditabbe, yattha sotañca nirujjhati saddasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe, yattha ghānañca nirujjhati gandhasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe,
sn35.117:1.8: yattha jivhā ca nirujjhati rasasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe, yattha kāyo ca nirujjhati phoṭṭhabbasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe,
sn35.117:1.9: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbeti.
sn35.117:1.10: idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
sn35.117:2.1: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi:
sn35.117:2.2: idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho.
sn35.117:2.3: “tasmātiha bhikkhave, se āyatane veditabbe yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati, rūpasaññā ca virajjati,
sn35.117:2.5: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati, se āyatane veditabbeti.
sn35.117:2.6: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti.
sn35.117:3.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
sn35.117:3.3: pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
sn35.117:3.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmāti.
sn35.117:4.1: atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
sn35.117:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn35.117:5.1: idaṃ kho no āvuso ānanda, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
sn35.117:5.2: “tasmātiha bhikkhave, se āyatane veditabbe. yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati
sn35.117:5.4: yattha mano ca nirujjhati, dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbeti.
sn35.117:5.5: tesaṃ no āvuso, amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi:
sn35.117:5.6: idaṃ kho no āvuso, bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho,
sn35.117:5.7: tasmātiha bhikkhave, se āyatane veditabbe, yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati, rūpasaññā ca virajjati,
sn35.117:5.9: yattha mano ca nirujjhati, dhammasaññā ca virajjati, se āyatane veditabbe”ti.
sn35.117:5.10: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti.
sn35.117:5.12: ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
sn35.117:5.13: pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
sn35.117:5.14: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmāti.
sn35.117:6.1: seyyathāpi āvuso, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva mūlaṃ atikkamma khandhaṃ sākhāpalāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya. evaṃ sampadamidaṃ. āyasmantānaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etamatthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha. sohāvuso bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato. so ceva panetassa kālo ahosi, yaṃ bhagavantaññeva etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha. yathā vo bhagavā vyākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti. addhā āvuso ānanda bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato. so ceva panetassa kālo ahosi, yaṃ bhagavantaññeva etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāma yathā no bhagavā vyākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma. api cāyasmā ānando satthuceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ, pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ,
sn35.117:7.2: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
sn35.117:8.1: yaṃ kho vo āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
sn35.117:8.2: tasmātiha bhikkhave se āyatane veditabbe, yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe …pe…
sn35.117:8.3: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbeti.
sn35.117:8.4: imassa khvāhaṃ āvuso bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
sn35.117:8.5: saḷāyatananirodhaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso bhagavatā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
sn35.117:8.6: “tasmātiha bhikkhave, se āyatane veditabbe, yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati, rūpasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe …pe…
sn35.117:8.7: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe”ti.
sn35.117:8.8: yaṃ kho āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
sn35.117:8.9: “tasmātiha bhikkhave se āyatane veditabbe, yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe …pe…
sn35.117:8.10: yattha mano ca nirujjhati, dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbeti
sn35.117:8.11: imassa khvāhaṃ āvuso bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
sn35.117:8.12: ākaṅkhamānā ca pana tumhe āyasmanto bhagavantaññeva upasaṅkamatha,
sn35.117:8.14: yathā vo bhagavā vyākaroti, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
sn35.117:9.1: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn35.117:10.1: yaṃ kho no bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
sn35.117:10.2: “tasmātiha bhikkhave se āyatane veditabbe, yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati
sn35.117:10.4: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe”ti tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi:
sn35.117:10.5: idaṃ kho no āvuso, bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
sn35.117:10.6: “tasmātiha bhikkhave se āyatane veditabbe yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe …pe…
sn35.117:10.7: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe”ti.
sn35.117:10.8: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti.
sn35.117:10.10: ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
sn35.117:10.11: pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
sn35.117:10.12: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmāti.
sn35.117:10.13: atha kho mayaṃ bhante, yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamimha upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipucchimha.
sn35.117:10.14: tesaṃ no bhante āyasmatā ānandena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi vyañjanehi attho vibhattoti.
sn35.117:11.1: paṇḍito bhikkhave ānando, mahāpañño bhikkhave ānando,
sn35.117:11.2: mañcepi tumhe bhikkhave etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, ahampi taṃ evamevaṃ vyākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ ānandena vyākataṃ.
sn35.117:11.3: eso kho cevetassa attho evañca naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
